name: Sootopolis City
lines:
This crater was created when a huge meteoroid
crashed into the earth here...
Over time, the crater filled with rainwater, and
that is how the city of Sootopolis came to be.

This narrow cave is all that links
Sootopolis to the outside world.
It’s almost as though this place was made
to keep something from getting out...
Or am I just imagining things?
